primary_observed_fact: The SEC primary 8-K reports only an amendment to FortuneX's existing Business Combination Agreement with WT Realty Group Inc. The amendment reduces aggregate merger consideration from 60,000,000 to 52,500,000 PubCo shares and otherwise leaves the business combination agreement in force. The filing contains no shareholder redemption notice, redemption deadline, trust-floor entitlement, extension vote redemption, or completion/redemption result.
decision_reason: Being a SPAC is not sufficient. The frozen SPAC-redemption family requires the specific redemption mechanism/clock defined by its protocol. This document is a merger-consideration amendment, not a redemption event, so it is eliminated before any admissible market-price or redemption-value access.
